description: This file defines an abstract Java class `AbstractApplicationClient` that serves as a base for command line clients accessing Hono's northbound APIs. It includes dependency injection for a client factory and configuration properties for tenant, device, and retry interval.

classes.name: AbstractApplicationClient
classes.description: An abstract base class for command line clients that interact with Hono's northbound APIs, providing common configuration and factory injection.

methods.name: setApplicationClientFactory
methods.description: Setter method to inject an ApplicationClientFactory dependency, ensuring it is non-null.
